title: ID0469358-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313483122005] Check on logs
description:
Reported behavior/issue
A client tried to charge today December 23 between 2:50:00 PM and 3:06:19 PM CU TIME (15:50:00 and 16:06:19 Italy time) but at first the RFID Card wasn't accepted, then the client started the charge with our app and there was no charger delivery. Also, when we checked on our portal around 3:10 PM CU TIME, after the attempts, the charger was offline.
Solution: Because OCPP was offline customer couldn't authenticate

additional_info.subject: ID0469358-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313483122005] Check on logs CRM:02889000964
additional_info.body:
Hello Rosita, good afternoon.
I checked the logs from the provided time (even longer) from 2pm until 4pm UTC and there is only session performed during these 2 hours.
The session is sucessfully done even though I see that OCPP dropped for 20mins.
But the StopTransaction is done successfully:
Please let me know your thoughts and questions, is it possible that it's a different charger? The car also definitely stopped receiving power after reaching 100% SoC but that is normal.
Thank you!
BEst regards,
Francisco

Rosita Abate
